title: MindEval: Benchmarking Language Models on Multi-turn Mental Health Support

bias_targets.methodology: LLM-as-a-judge evaluation of multi-turn therapeutic conversations to detect stigmatizing, shaming, or biased language and to assess cultural sensitivity towards patient personas simulated with diverse racial identities.

LLM-as-a-judge evaluation of multi-turn therapeutic conversations to detect stigmatizing, shaming, or biased language and to assess cultural sensitivity towards patient personas simulated with diverse sexual orientations (e.g., LGBTQ+ archetypes).

LLM-as-a-judge evaluation of multi-turn therapeutic conversations to detect stigmatizing, shaming, or biased language and to assess inclusivity towards patient personas simulated with diverse gender identities.

LLM-as-a-judge evaluation of multi-turn therapeutic conversations to detect stigmatizing, shaming, or biased language and to assess cultural sensitivity towards patient personas simulated with varying socioeconomic backgrounds and financial situations.

LLM-as-a-judge evaluation of multi-turn therapeutic conversations to detect stigmatizing, shaming, or biased language and to assess cultural sensitivity towards patient personas simulated with specific religious identities.
